re: `k2.6` vs. `k2.6-code-preview`
updated `packages/opencode/src/provider/transform.ts` to use the explicit model ID kimi-k2.6-code-preview.

re: unrelated changes
upstream commit history messed up and got accidentally bundled into the branch; already rebased. also meant to open the PR as draft before the gh checks pass.

I have an RTL branch ready that takes a different approach from the existing PRs — instead of wrapping elements with `dir="rtl"`, it replaces all physical CSS properties and Tailwind classes with logical equivalents across `packages/ui` and `packages/app` (67 files):

- CSS: `padding-left` → `padding-inline-start`, `right` → `inset-inline-end`, etc.
- Tailwind: `pl-` → `ps-`, `pr-` → `pe-`, `text-left` → `text-start`, etc.
- `dir="auto"` on user content for bidi detection
- `dir="ltr"` on code blocks, terminal, switches that should never flip
- CSS + Tailwind lint tests to prevent regression
- Playwright e2e test for sidebar flipping

Would this approach be acceptable before I open a PR? Happy to share the branch for review.

_The following comment was made by an LLM, it may be inaccurate:_

Found a related PR:

**PR #20677: feat(opencode): voice mode — STT, TTS, continuous mode, VAD, barge-in**
https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/20677

This PR appears to be a related/overlapping feature that implements voice functionality including STT (speech-to-text), TTS (text-to-speech), and additional voice capabilities. It may be addressing similar requirements or could be a previous/alternative approach to voice input support.

I wasn't having an issue with the sessions not loading unless I specifically reloaded the webview, but it was not finding any files when searching using `@`. I can confirm that opening with disabled `OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_FILEWATCHER` as mentioned by @dialupdisaster fixed it for me.

@Brendonovich using the terminal, launching via `/Applications/OpenCode.app/Contents/MacOS/OpenCode` seems to work fine.
Launching using Spotlight or Raycast seems to put the Desktop app's chats into a permanent pending/loading state.

I don't know if it's fixed in the latest version 'cause I have disabled compaction. But the problem seems to be

1. Plan agent spawns Explore sub-agent (no edit permission)
2. Context compaction
3. a General sub-agent (with edit permission) is spawned to continue previous task

it looks like the General sub-agent is the default option for spawning a sub-agent?
@Brendonovich just tried both, seems like launching via terminal works regardless of the OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_FILEWATCHER flag.
we rolled desktop back to 1.4.3 while we investigate

> have you verified setting agent.prompt in opencode.json works to replace the base prompt?

I have, yes. Even before https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/issues/7101#issuecomment-4247915864, I've been experimenting with decreasing the bloat for the primary agents and subagents, and the approach works.

See: https://github.com/font44/opencode-lite as a proof of concept.

On a side note, even the tool descriptions are quite bloated in OpenCode. I was building a plugin to decrease that too and, even though the plugin works, it relies on some `experimental` APIs and so not sure when the plugin will break.
